column1: # Real typos must still get corrected. Without this bucket, "fix the false
# positives" degenerates into "suggest nothing", which scores perfectly on
# `hte -> the` is the transposition class: spellingConfidence uses plain
# Levenshtein (distance 2) rather than the Damerau distance used elsewhere
# (distance 1), so transpositions score low and can fall under the display
